findings.evidence: <select id="dob-day-select" autocomplete="bday-day" required=""> <select id="dob-month-select" autocomplete="bday-month" required=""> <select id="dob-year-select" autocomplete="bday-year" required="">
findings.fix: Use three short text fields for day, month and year, with the numeric input mode.
findings.violation: A date the person knows by heart is picked from three drop-downs, the year from 60 options.

findings.evidence: The form's heading reads 'Create your account' and its submit button reads 'Create account', yet required fields include <input id="website-input" name="website" ... required> (line 37), <input id="member-input" name="membership_number" ... required> (line 41), <input id="acctnum-input" name="account_number" ... required> (line 45), <select id="shipspeed-select" required> (line 53), <input id="org-input" name="organization" ... required> (line 67), <input id="contacttime-input" name="contact_time" ... required> (line 71), and the date-of-birth fieldset's three required selects (lines 77-187).
findings.fix: Remove the company-website, membership-number, account-number, shipping-speed, organization-name, contact-time and date-of-birth fields from account creation, and ask for any of them later, only when a step that actually uses the answer needs it.

instances.evidence: <input id="member-input" name="membership_number" type="text" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="Must be 8 digits" required="">
<fieldset id="row-dob"><legend>Date of birth</legend> ... <select id="dob-day-select" autocomplete="bday-day" required="">

findings.violation: The task this form states is creating an account, but it requires a company website, a membership number, an account number, a shipping-speed preference, an organization name, a preferred contact time and a date of birth, none of which account creation uses; a membership or account number is especially self-defeating to demand before the account that would issue one exists.

findings.evidence: <input id="postal-input" name="postal_code" type="text" autocomplete="postal-code" required="" size="3"> (size=3)
findings.fix: Size the field to show at least 5 characters.
findings.violation: This postal code field shows 3 characters, too few to show a typical value whole while it is typed and checked.

findings.fix: Loosen the pattern to accept every valid way of writing the value, and normalise it after submission.
findings.violation: The pattern on this phone field rejects valid values such as +44 20 7946 0958; 020 7946 0958.

findings.evidence: <button id="viewdetails-btn" type="button" style="padding:12px 20px;font-size:16px">View details</button> sits between the 'Preferred contact time' row (line 69-72) and the date-of-birth fieldset (line 74), while the primary submit <button id="submit-btn" type="submit">Create account</button> (line 189) carries no styling at all.
findings.fix: Move 'View details' out of the field column entirely, or style it as visibly lesser than the primary submit action, and keep the primary action at the end of the fields, in line with them.
findings.violation: A secondary action sits in the middle of the field column, separating the date-of-birth fieldset from the rest of the form, and is styled more prominently (explicit padding and font-size) than the unstyled primary submit button, so a person cannot tell by appearance which control finishes the form.

findings.evidence: <label id="legalname-label" for="legalname-input">Your name</label> <input id="legalname-input" name="legal_name" type="text" autocomplete="name" required=""> duplicates <label id="name-label" for="name-input">Full name</label> <input id="name-input" name="full_name" type="text" autocomplete="name" required=""> at line 12.
findings.fix: Remove the second name field and reuse the one answer already collected, or relabel it to explain a genuinely different need such as a legal name that differs from the preferred name.
findings.violation: The form asks for the person's name twice, as 'Full name' and again eight fields later as 'Your name', an answer the form already has.

findings.fix: Set the field's font size to at least 16 pixels.
findings.violation: The text in this field is 13 pixels, below the 16 pixels at which a phone stops zooming the page on focus.
